anonymisation.definition: Removing names or other identifying details from statistics, open data or reports.
anonymisation.label: Anonymisation

back-office-access-control.definition: Restricting who reaches internal or back-office functions, e.g. only staff with a city badge; roles and permissions.
back-office-access-control.label: Back-office access control

bookings-rentals-and-loans.definition: Reserving or borrowing a time, place or item: lane and hall bookings, plot reservations, guided tours, drop-off slots, stall allocations, bike rentals, library loans.
bookings-rentals-and-loans.label: Bookings, rentals and loans

case-handling.definition: How staff create, change and manage individual cases or records during their life, and the screens they use for it.
case-handling.label: Case handling

case-priority.definition: Priority of cases as data in the product: grouping, filtering, sorting, searching or counting cases by priority. Not the priority field of the requirement itself.
case-priority.label: Case priority

case-status-for-residents.definition: Residents can see where their own case or request stands (its status or progress).
case-status-for-residents.label: Case status for residents

central-database.definition: Keeping records in the city's central database rather than in local or separate stores.
central-database.label: Central database

change-history.definition: Keeping a history or audit trail of every change to a record: what changed, who changed it and when.
change-history.label: Change history

city-design-system.definition: Reusing the city's shared design system, its components and styles.
city-design-system.label: City design system

clerk-efficiency.definition: Reducing the administrative effort of staff: less paperwork, replacing manual tools, and keeping the terms they already know.
clerk-efficiency.label: Clerk efficiency

clerks.definition: Office clerks or desk staff who handle cases: their screens, actions (assign, merge, handle) and workload.
clerks.label: Clerks

concurrent-editing.definition: Two or more users changing the same record at the same time: edit conflicts, lost updates, locking.
concurrent-editing.label: Concurrent editing

consent.definition: Consent rules for processing personal data, e.g. following the GDPR consent rules.
consent.label: Consent

credential-protection.definition: Safe handling of passwords and credentials: never kept in the browser, the risk of stolen passwords, waiting or lock-out after failed attempts.
credential-protection.label: Credential protection

data-access-requests.definition: Residents can obtain or download all data held about them.
data-access-requests.label: Data access requests

data-export.definition: Exporting records from the system to files such as CSV or spreadsheets for use elsewhere.
data-export.label: Data export

data-loss.definition: Records being lost, overwritten or not saved (e.g. work made offline, two people changing the same record), and protections against it.
data-loss.label: Data loss

data-refresh-interval.definition: How often shown data is refreshed or updated automatically, e.g. records refreshed every N minutes. Not the sync of field devices (see Field app synchronisation).
data-refresh-interval.label: Data refresh interval

data-retention.definition: How long personal data (e.g. photos of residents) may be kept and when it must be deleted.
data-retention.label: Data retention

data-storage-and-integrity.definition: Where case data is kept and how it is protected against loss, duplication or corruption.
data-storage-and-integrity.label: Data storage and integrity

date-formats.definition: How dates (and similar values) are formatted and displayed, including dates shown in the wrong format.
date-formats.label: Date formats

devices-and-channels.definition: The hardware and channels through which the system is used: staff tablets, phones, public kiosks and paper printouts.
devices-and-channels.label: Devices and channels

district-boundaries.definition: The city's division into districts and its boundaries file, including constraints that the district definitions must not change.
district-boundaries.label: District boundaries

district-rollout.definition: Applying a change to all or some districts from a given release; phased introduction across the city.
district-rollout.label: District rollout

editing-and-moving-records.definition: Changing an existing record: editing its fields, or moving it to another date, type, team, street, district, status or age group; editing features.
editing-and-moving-records.label: Editing and moving records

familiar-terminology.definition: Keeping the wording and terms users (e.g. clerks) already use in screens and texts.
familiar-terminology.label: Familiar terminology

faster-answers-to-residents.definition: Answering or serving residents faster as a goal: shorter waiting and handling times from the resident's point of view.
faster-answers-to-residents.label: Faster answers to residents

faults-repairs-and-complaints.definition: Reports of something wrong to be fixed or handled: lamp faults, housing repair requests, noise complaints.
faults-repairs-and-complaints.label: Faults, repairs and complaints

field-app-synchronisation.definition: Exchange of data between field devices and the central system: how often the field app syncs, uploading work made offline, conflicts on sync.
field-app-synchronisation.label: Field app synchronisation

field-staff.definition: Staff who work on site with a field app or tablet: recording cases, adding photos, working offline.
field-staff.label: Field staff

filtering.definition: Narrowing a list of records by one or more criteria, e.g. 'can be filtered by team and status'.
filtering.label: Filtering

finding-records.definition: Locating records in lists: searching, filtering, sorting, and checking that a record can be found in the list.
finding-records.label: Finding records

inspections-and-visits.definition: Checks and visits by staff: tree inspections, pump checks, meter readings, elder care home visits.
inspections-and-visits.label: Inspections and visits

interface-response-time.definition: A limit on how quickly an interface, service or component answers a request, e.g. 'the X interface answers within N seconds'; mostly integration tests.
interface-response-time.label: Interface response time

invoicing.definition: Creating invoices, e.g. an invoice created when a case is approved.
invoicing.label: Invoicing

kinds-of-case.definition: What kind of thing the case handled by an element is, across services: bookings, permits, inspections, faults or operational runs.
kinds-of-case.label: Kinds of case

list-behaviour.definition: How record lists behave: a newly created record appears in the list, the list keeps its position after saving instead of jumping to the top.
list-behaviour.label: List behaviour

map-display.definition: What a map shows and over what area, e.g. every case within N metres, and whether the map is readable.
map-display.label: Map display

map-tile-rendering.definition: How map tiles or map images are produced and delivered, e.g. rendered on the server instead of the device.
map-tile-rendering.label: Map tile rendering

maps-and-location.definition: Geographic presentation and location of cases: maps, distances in metres, map tiles, and districts or streets treated as places.
maps-and-location.label: Maps and location

merging-duplicates.definition: Combining two records of the same case into one (merge, combine, de-duplicate).
merging-duplicates.label: Merging duplicates

multi-factor-authentication.definition: Two-factor or multi-factor checks at sign-in.
multi-factor-authentication.label: Multi-factor authentication

nightly-copies.definition: Nightly copies of the data (backups or snapshots, also used to build reports) and checks that they hold every record.
nightly-copies.label: Nightly copies

offline-and-field-work.definition: Work done by staff away from the office on mobile devices: recording on site, working without network, and keeping field devices in step with the central system.
offline-and-field-work.label: Offline and field work

offline-operation.definition: The app keeps working without a network connection for a stated time, or the risk that work done offline is lost.
offline-operation.label: Offline operation

on-site-recording.definition: Staff capture or record a case at the location itself (on site, in the field) rather than at a desk; field work features.
on-site-recording.label: On-site recording

open-case-overview.definition: Overview screens and counts of how many cases are open, broken down by status, team, priority, district, street, age or date; overview features.
open-case-overview.label: Open-case overview

operational-runs-and-events.definition: Planned operations and events: gritting runs, waste pickups, road closures, public transport route changes, park events.
operational-runs-and-events.label: Operational runs and events

overdue-cases.definition: Detecting and showing late cases: thresholds such as 'waits more than N days', marking a case late, supervisors seeing which cases are late.
overdue-cases.label: Overdue cases

page-load-time.definition: A limit on how quickly a page or screen (for example the overview page) opens or renders for the user, usually stated in seconds.
page-load-time.label: Page load time

paperwork-reduction.definition: Cutting the paper-based work of clerks, e.g. halving paperwork.
paperwork-reduction.label: Paperwork reduction

payment-methods.definition: How and when payment is taken: paying a fee online, charging a card only after confirmation, coins and contactless at a kiosk.
payment-methods.label: Payment methods

payments-and-fees.definition: Money between residents and the city: fees and prices, how and when residents pay, invoices and refunds.
payments-and-fees.label: Payments and fees

performance.definition: Speed of the system as users experience it: how fast pages open, interfaces answer or data is refreshed, including time limits in seconds or minutes and the tests that measure them.
performance.label: Performance

permits-registrations-and-applicatio.definition: Requests for permission or membership that are decided on: parking permits, dog registrations, building applications, school enrolments, workshop sign-ups.
permits-registrations-and-applicatio.label: Permits, registrations and applications

personal-data-confidentiality.definition: Keeping personal details such as home addresses or resident records from people who should not see them, including other residents and intruders.
personal-data-confidentiality.label: Personal data confidentiality

photo-attachments.definition: Adding photos or images to a record, and rules for the photos that are stored.
photo-attachments.label: Photo attachments

prices-and-fee-tables.definition: What a service costs and how that is shown or set: price shown before booking, the fee table set by the finance office.
prices-and-fee-tables.label: Prices and fee tables

printing.definition: Paper output: printing a record, fitting it on one A4 page, printable layouts.
printing.label: Printing

privacy-and-personal-data.definition: Handling of residents' personal data under data protection law (GDPR): consent, residents' rights, anonymisation, confidentiality and retention.
privacy-and-personal-data.label: Privacy and personal data

public-kiosk.definition: Self-service kiosk screens in public places: what they display (e.g. today's cases), how they identify residents, how they take payment, lock-out after failed attempts.
public-kiosk.label: Public kiosk

record-creation.definition: Creating a new record or case (registration, booking, application, ...) and checking that it was stored.
record-creation.label: Record creation

refunds.definition: Paying money back to residents: refund deadlines, and errors such as a refund paid twice.
refunds.label: Refunds

release-and-rollout.definition: When and where a change takes effect: deadlines tied to seasons, releases, and rollout across districts.
release-and-rollout.label: Release and rollout

reminders-and-due-dates.definition: Notifications sent ahead of a due date (e.g. N days before), and reminder features.
reminders-and-due-dates.label: Reminders and due dates

report-timeliness.definition: Reports being produced on time, e.g. the risk that reports are late at month end, and decisions on how report data is prepared to avoid delays.
report-timeliness.label: Report timeliness

reporting-and-statistics.definition: Summaries of the data for management and others: periodic reports, counts, groupings, statistics, exports, and producing them on time.
reporting-and-statistics.label: Reporting and statistics

resident-identification.definition: How residents prove who they are: signing in before sending a request, the national e-ID app, a kiosk asking who they are before showing their cases; anonymous use refused.
resident-identification.label: Resident identification

resident-service.definition: Service to residents as the public users of the city: transparency about their own cases and how quickly they get an answer.
resident-service.label: Resident service

residents.definition: Residents as users or subjects: what they see, submit, pay or are told, and their personal data.
residents.label: Residents

right-to-erasure.definition: Residents can have their records or personal data removed.
right-to-erasure.label: Right to erasure

search.definition: Searching records by a criterion such as district, team, status, street, type, date or priority.
search.label: Search

seasonal-deadlines.definition: Something needed before a season starts, e.g. before the spring season.
seasonal-deadlines.label: Seasonal deadlines

security-and-access.definition: Protecting the system from unauthorised use: who may sign in and how, sessions, credentials, and which functions each kind of user may reach.
security-and-access.label: Security and access

session-management.definition: Session tokens and their lifetime: expiry after inactivity, sign-out.
session-management.label: Session management

single-screen-handling.definition: Doing all the work on one case in a single screen, without switching between screens, forms or systems.
single-screen-handling.label: Single-screen handling

small-screens-and-phones.definition: Use on mobile phones or small displays, including readability and layout problems on small screens.
small-screens-and-phones.label: Small screens and phones

sorting.definition: The order in which a list of records is shown, e.g. sorted by date, status, priority or team.
sorting.label: Sorting

spreadsheet-replacement.definition: Replacing the spreadsheets or manual lists in use today with the system.
spreadsheet-replacement.label: Spreadsheet replacement

staff-authentication.definition: How staff prove their identity: login with the city identity provider, badge login, extra checks for supervisors.
staff-authentication.label: Staff authentication

stakeholder-agreement.definition: A requirement or decision agreed with a named group (service desk, back office, mobile, field, platform or data team) in a review.
stakeholder-agreement.label: Stakeholder agreement

supervisor-approval.definition: A supervisor must approve a case before it is published or takes effect; approval steps that trigger follow-up actions.
supervisor-approval.label: Supervisor approval

supervisors.definition: Supervisors who oversee work: approving cases, seeing late cases, extra security checks for them.
supervisors.label: Supervisors

tablets.definition: Use on staff tablets, including working with existing tablet hardware (e.g. bought in 2021) and measurements on the slowest supported tablet.
tablets.label: Tablets

team-assignment.definition: Assigning cases to teams, moving them between teams, or showing workload per team.
team-assignment.label: Team assignment

user-interface-design.definition: Look and consistency of the screens: shared design system, display formats and visual conventions.
user-interface-design.label: User interface design

user-roles.definition: The kind of person an element is about or written for: clerks, supervisors, field staff or residents.
user-roles.label: User roles

weekly-report.definition: The weekly report: what it counts and how it groups records (by street, age, status, district, ...), and tests that it counts every record.
weekly-report.label: Weekly report

work-queue.definition: A single shared queue or intake for incoming cases of a kind, and how cases wait in it.
work-queue.label: Work queue

workflow-and-deadlines.definition: How work is routed and timed: intake queues, assignment to teams, approval, due dates, reminders, lateness and priority of cases.
workflow-and-deadlines.label: Workflow and deadlines
